commands.command: readme_paths=$(rg --files -g 'README*' -g '!tests/**' -g '!plan/**' -g '!.chongdae/**' | sort); if [ -n "$readme_paths" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$readme_paths"; fi
python3 ./build.py; status=$?; echo "exit=$status"; find docs -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort

sed -n '1,240p' docs/index.html; echo '--- alpha ---'; sed -n '1,240p' docs/p/alpha.html; echo '--- beta ---'; sed -n '1,200p' docs/p/beta.html; echo '--- time.js ---'; sed -n '1,200p' docs/assets/time.js; echo '--- css ---'; sed -n '1,160p' docs/assets/site.css

find docs -maxdepth 3 -type f -print | sort; echo '--- image post ---'; sed -n '1,180p' docs/p/imagepost.html; echo '--- feed image entry ---'; rg -n -C 2 'imagepost|친구 사진|avatar' docs/index.html; echo '--- copied image ---'; cmp content/images/avatar.png docs/images/avatar.png; echo "cmp_exit=$?"

first=$(find docs -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum); python3 ./build.py; second=$(find docs -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum); if [ "$first" = "$second" ]; then echo 'byte-identical rebuild: yes'; else echo 'byte-identical rebuild: no'; fi
sed -n '10,120p' docs/index.html; echo '--- escape page ---'; sed -n '10,100p' docs/p/escape.html

before=$(find docs -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum); python3 ./build.py 2>error.txt; rc=$?; after=$(find docs -type f -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 shasum); printf 'exit=%s
' "$rc"; printf 'stderr='; tr '
' '|' < error.txt; printf '
'; if [ "$before" = "$after" ]; then echo 'docs unchanged: yes'; else echo 'docs unchanged: no'; fi
python3 ./build.py; rc=$?; echo "exit=$rc"; rg -n -C 1 'imagefallback|풍경 설명' docs/index.html

python3 ./build.py; rc=$?; echo "build_exit=$rc"; rg -n -C 1 '0001-01-02' docs/p/ancient.html docs/index.html; TZ=UTC node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const el={dateTime:"0001-01-02T03:04:05Z",textContent:"",title:"",getAttribute:()=>"0001-01-02 03:04 UTC"}; global.document={querySelectorAll:()=>[el]}; eval(fs.readFileSync("docs/assets/time.js","utf8")); console.log(JSON.stringify({text:el.textContent,title:el.title}));'
